title: Rust: DIS and DAO-ACK codecs + vector consumers in lichen-rpl
description: lichen-rpl/src/message.rs has CODE_DIS/CODE_DAO_ACK constants but no Dis or DaoAck structs; the rpl_messages.json consumer test (every_dio_matches_committed_cross_language_vectors) only exercises type==dio vectors. The 10 new DIS/DAO-ACK vectors (beads project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.5.6.3.5, project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.5.6.5.4) are Python-validated only. Implement Dis (flags/reserved, reserved!=0 rejected, option chain) and DaoAck ([instance, D|flags, seq, status] with optional 16-byte DODAGID) mirroring python/src/lichen/rpl/messages.py:152-516, then add a data-driven test over rpl_messages.json type==dis and type==dao_ack vectors incl. expect_error mapping (too_short => TooShort, nonzero_reserved/missing_dodagid => InvalidOption-style errors). Discovered-from: project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.5.6.3.5
